etymology_text: Inherited from Chagatai اولار (ʾwlʾr), from Proto-Turkic *o-lar. By surface analysis, u (“that; he/she/it”) + -lar (plural suffix). Cognate with Uyghur ئۇلار / ular / улар. Compare also Azerbaijani اونلار / онлар / onlar and Turkish onlar.
label: miras

etymology_text: Inherited from Chagatai خواهلاماق (xwāhlamaq). from Persian خواه (xwāh, “to want”) + Chagatai ـلاماق (-lamaq, verb-deriving suffix). By surface analysis, xoh + -la + -moq. Compare Kazakh қалау (qalaw), which is from the same root and morphologically equivalent.
label: miras

etymology_text:
Inherited from Chagatai ییغلاماق (yiğlamaq), from Proto-Turkic *yï̄gla- (“to weep”).
Cognates
* Bashkir илау (ilaw)
* Kumyk йыламакъ (yılamaq)
* Azerbaijani ağlamaq
* Khalaj hığlamaq
* Turkish ağlamak
* Gagauz aalamaa
gloss: to cry, to weep, to shed tears; to emit tears from the eye, especially as an expression of emotion
label: miras
